prompt: A repository fixture has eval/base and three feature branches. Which of feature/merged, feature/active, and feature/old-unmerged have tips reachable from eval/base? Return answers.reachable and answers.not_reachable as comma-separated, alphabetically sorted branch names.

Among feature/merged, feature/active, and feature/old-unmerged, which local branch tracks an origin branch? Return answers.branch, answers.ahead, and answers.behind relative to its cached tracking ref. Use decimal strings for the counts.
